title: Your Kitchen Just Got Smarter for the Holidays: GE Appliances Updates Connected Appliances to Simplify the Year’s Busiest Cooking Season
summary: iHeartMedia is a leading global media and entertainment company specializing in radio, digital, mobile, social, live events and on-demand entertainment.
body_markdown:
*New over-the-air software updates bring seamless entertainment, recipe inspiration, and personalized organization directly to GE Profile™, CAFÉ™ and Monogram™ screens to make holiday hosting easier than ever*


**LOUISVILLE, Ky., Nov. 23, 2026** — As families prepare for the busiest cooking and entertaining season of the year, GE Appliances is rolling out a series of new features via over-the-air (OTA) software updates to select GE Profile™, CAFÉ™, and Monogram™ smart appliances. Designed to ease the hustle of holiday hosting, these new features bring entertainment, seasonal culinary inspiration, and personalized organizational tools directly to the appliances.


These new features build on the technology featured in both the GE Profile Smart 4-Door French-Door Refrigerator with Kitchen Assistant™ and smart wall ovens featuring Cooking Assistant. By continually delivering new value long after purchase, these updates turn the kitchen into a smarter, more helpful partner just in time for hosting season.


“We believe appliances should continue to get better long after they arrive in your home,” said Rachael Schwartz, executive director, product management at GE Appliances. “Through over-the-air software updates, we're able to introduce new capabilities that directly support our customers during their busiest times of the year. From keeping track of holiday schedules to finding recipe inspiration on the spot, it’s about making hosting simpler and more enjoyable so families can focus on what matters most.”


The latest over-the-air (OTA) software updates introduce new experiences tailored to make holiday meal prep and kitchen gathering more seamless and stress-free:


- **Simplify Holiday Meal Planning with HelloFresh (Available Now):** From finding last-minute dinner inspiration to getting ingredients delivered right to your door, meal planning has never been more convenient. For the first time, home cooks can access HelloFresh recipes directly on their appliance displays without a subscription, where hosts can browse seasonal recipes or scan an on-screen QR code to explore convenient meal kit options for those dinners in between the big festivities.
- **Keep Holiday Schedules and Memories in View (Available Now):** From tracking school pageants and travel plans to organizing dinner parties, a new calendar widget allows consumers to connect their Google Calendar accounts and view their upcoming holiday schedules directly on their kitchen appliance display, enabling easier household coordination.
- **Personalize the Display with Google Photos (Available Now):** After countless requests, GE Appliances is bringing homeowners the capability to add their own cherished photos to their appliance sleep screen. By connecting with Google Photos, they can transform their display into a personalized digital photo frame.
- **Bring Entertainment into the Kitchen with iHeartRadio (Coming Soon):** Set the perfect festive mood while preparing seasonal feasts. Soon, hosts can stream their favorite holiday music, live radio stations and podcasts directly on their appliance displays. This over-the-air addition provides instant kitchen entertainment, keeping countertops free of extra device clutter and eliminating the need to manage phone playlists with messy, flour-covered hands.


“Audio is a cornerstone of the holiday traditions that bring loved ones together, especially when the kitchen is bustling with festive energy,” said Conal Byrne, CEO of the iHeart Digital Audio Group for iHeartMedia. “Our upcoming integration with GE Appliances will bring all our favorite holiday music, seasonal podcasts, and live radio stations directly into the heart of the home. We are thrilled to make it even easier for hosts to set the perfect holiday soundtrack and bring some extra joy to their cooking routines right from their smart kitchen displays very soon.”


These additions represent the next chapter for GE Appliances' connected kitchen portfolio, specifically elevating the GE Profile Smart 4-Door French-Door Refrigerator with Kitchen Assistant™ and smart wall ovens featuring Cooking Assistant technology. Introduced earlier this year, Kitchen Assistant™ simplifies daily routines with tools like Scan-to-List grocery management and shared shopping lists, while Cooking Assistant supports homeowners throughout the cooking process with step-by-step recipe guidance and built-in, in-oven camera technology.


Beyond these new integrations, GE Appliances continues to refine existing capabilities through ongoing software enhancements, such as improved in-oven camera food recognition and expanded food detection. By delivering continuous enhancements through software updates, GE Appliances ensures that compatible products grow smarter and more useful over time, without requiring consumers to replace their physical appliances.


For more information about GE Appliances' connected kitchen innovations, visit[pressroom.geappliances.com](https://pressroom.geappliances.com/media-kit/2026-kbis-press-kit) .
